Addepar is hiring a Software Engineering Manager for our New Workflow Platform. We are pivoting from a SaaS suite to a global orchestration platform. We’re looking for a hands-on leader with 2+ years of management experience and a deep understanding of workflow technologies such as Temporal, n8n, Pipedream and Distributed Systems. Lead a team of Senior Staff engineers building the "Agentic Fabric" of the financial world.This is a hybrid role in our NYC office. Hybrid | NYC | Python/Java

Job description: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/addepar1/jobs/8460804002 Reach out directly here: douglas.clifford@addepar.com
